title: The Sneezing Sheep
offer: Our sheep sneezes and sneezes. Row to the island of Laxön and ask Tova the healer what helps.

steps.say: A sneezing sheep? It has a cold. Thyme helps: here is a bundle. Steam it in warm water and let her breathe it.
She breathed the thyme steam, and look: no more sneezing! Tova says you have a good hand with animals.

fact: The vikings knew many healing herbs: thyme, chamomile, yarrow and garlic.
